{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Define QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Define refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH, EXCLUDING QA orders and refunded orders
# The question asks for the fraction of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH who converted.
# We must exclude QA orders (not real) and refunded orders (not completed)
# So: channel == 'paid_search', customer_segment == 'new', NOT in qa_orders, NOT refunded
filtered_clean = df[
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (~df['revenue_numeric'].isin([999999.99])) & 
    (df['status'] != 'refunded')
]

# Check how many such rows exist
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (cleaned):", len(filtered_clean))

# Now compute conversion rate: fraction of these who converted (converted == 1)
converted_count_clean = filtered_clean['converted'].sum()
total_count_clean = len(filtered_clean)
conversion_rate_clean = converted_count_clean / total_count_clean

print(f"Converted (cleaned): {converted_count_clean}, Total (cleaned): {total_count_clean}, Rate: {conversion_rate_clean:.4f}")"}
